dict.string: Brenda listens only while you hold the talk shortcut, and turns what you say into text on this computer.
Brenda asks Finder which files and folders you've selected, and empties the Trash only when you ask and say yes.
Brenda works on files in your Documents folder only when you ask her to, and never deletes anything.
Brenda works on files on your Desktop, and saves screenshots there, only when you ask her to.
Brenda works on files in your Downloads folder only when you ask her to, and never deletes anything.
